paragraphs.text: Camel is a rarely used creature type for a species of humped, long-necked ruminant mammal, domesticated in desert regions as a beast of burden and a source of wool, milk, and meat.
The creature type includes both one-humped dromedaries and double-humped Bactrian camels .
Camels are mostly white -aligned. However, Quarry Hauler ( AKH ) and Wretched Camel ( HOU ) are mono- green and mono- black , respectively.
For many years, the only camel card was Camel from Arabian Nights . All creatures attacking in a band with camels are immune to damage done by deserts .
Years later, the Dromad Purebred was printed in Ravnica: City of Guilds , followed by Tasseled Dromedary in Kaladesh and multiple camels in Amonkhet block .
Modern Horizons 2 featured the colorless artifact Steel Dromedary .
Camels can be found on many planes, including Amonkhet , Arcavios , Avishkar , Rabiah , and Ravnica .
Dromads are giant camels with no humps used as mounts on the plane of Ravnica .
